newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan PM cautious on need for extra budget -- Jiji.
newsitem.headline: Japan PM cautious on need for extra budget -- Jiji.

text.p: Further consideration is necessary before a decision on whether a supplementary budget of about five trillion yen is needed for Japan's economy, Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto was quoted on Wednesday as saying.
"We need further consideration on whether a supplementary budget of such a size would be necessary," Hashimoto was quoted as saying by Jiji news agency.

He was referring to media reports earlier in the day quoting senior officials of his Liberal Democratic Party as saying that the government should come up with a five trillion yen extra budget after general elections on October 20.
"There are about six trillion yen worth of public works projects left. The final decision should be made after getting a firm grasp of economic conditions," Hashimoto was quoted as saying.
